An X-iter feature is purchased by pressing the X-iter button, selecting X-iter mode showing the cost in the player's currency, and pressing the Spin button.
The X-iter features can only be activated in the base game.
The theoretical payout (RTP) for all X-iter game modes are __RTP__.
The minimum X-iter cost is __MINBABMODE__, the maximum X-iter cost is __MAXBABMODE__.
All game rules apply in X-iter mode.

X-iter rules
The X-iter feature offers buy-in to different game modes.
SUPER BONUS: 
Buy a game round triggering the Bonus game, starting with a Win Multiplier of 10x. Cost is __X05_MULTIPLIER__ the bet.
BUY BONUS: 
Buy a game round triggering the Bonus game. Cost is __X04_MULTIPLIER__ the bet.
LOCKED WILDS: 
Buy a game round with 3 Locked Wilds initially dropping into the grid. Cost is __X03_MULTIPLIER__ the bet.
FEATURE CRESCENDO: 
Buy a game round with more feature or "7" symbols dropping into the grid. Cost is __X02_MULTIPLIER__ the bet.
BONUS HUNT:
